preamble: The glottal fricative [h] is strengthened to the velar fricative [x]. In Guaymí (Ngäbere, Chibchan), word-initial Proto-Chibchan *h became x before vowels, as in *hu > /xu/ 'house' and *hi > /xi/ 'path'; before u it was either x or lost (*hũ 'pot' > uɡwẽ).

examples.note: Pache (2018): *h > x word-initially before vowels other than u, and *h > x or zero before u.

sources: Pache, M. J. (2018). Contributions to Chibchan Historical Linguistics. https://hdl.handle.net/1887/67094
